issue.title: Dependabot config + safe dependency merge workflow
issue.body:
## Summary

Add **Dependabot configuration** and a documented **safe dependency merge workflow** for Fluent Mobile.

## What shipped

- `.github/dependabot.yml` — weekly npm + GitHub Actions update schedule.
- A documented safe-merge workflow: merge **one** Dependabot PR at a time, rebase others after `main` CI is green (npm-only / `package-lock.json`).

## Attribution

Delivered by @mattrace-gloo in [PR #60](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/60) (merged).

## Status

**Completed** — closing as completed. Tracking/credit issue.

Refs #60.
